_README: One entry per site: where things are, what you may do there, and how to get in.
access: open (no login) | session (log in once by hand, then the agent works) |
api (use the official API instead, see prefer) | blocked (do not automate, see why).
hosts: hostnames the entry covers (subdomains included). Pointer actions refuse to run on a blocked host.

claude_ai.label: Claude.ai
claude_ai.why: Consumer terms forbid automated access, and accounts driven by third-party harnesses were suspended in Feb-Apr 2026.
claude_ai.prefer: Claude Code headless (claude -p) or the Anthropic API

perplexity.label: Perplexity
perplexity.why: Automating the consumer UI violates the terms; login is a magic link, so it cannot be automated anyway. Plain GETs return 403.

tradingview.label: TradingView
tradingview.why: The terms forbid not only scraping but building or using tools that enable it. The tool itself is in scope.
tradingview.prefer: an exchange or broker market-data API

teamblind.label: Blind (teamblind)
teamblind.why: The account is tied to a work-email identity; a lock is the most expensive to recover. Login paths are JS modals, no reliable signal.

baemin.label: 배달의민족
baemin.why: No consumer web login at all (app only).

toss_invest.label: 토스증권
toss_invest.why: QR-only login, and the session can send real orders. Money-moving actions are for humans.

srail.label: SRT 예약 (etk.srail.kr)
srail.why: Filling the search form by script and submitting once triggered an 'abnormal access, IP blocked' page with a membership-loss warning (2026-10-05). Even searching is done by a human in the app.

kakaotalk_client.label: 카카오톡 클라이언트 (PC/모바일)
kakaotalk_client.why: Kakao operating policy 3-2(23) bans unapproved programs calling the protocol; usage patterns alone can trigger restrictions. In March 2021 a wave of bans hit bot accounts and their owners' main accounts.
kakaotalk_client.prefer: Kakao Developers 'send to me' for personal alerts; Telegram (officially allows user-account automation) for bots

kling_ai.label: Kling AI
kling_ai.why: A sliding captcha iframe covers the sign-up submit button (2026-09-02). Captcha means stop for the day; do not try to solve it.

jedec.label: JEDEC
jedec.why: Member login wall; scripts get 403. Standards text is not reachable this way.
